description: Lab buffer recipe (grams to weigh) — Buffer preparation recipe for a target pH: picks the best buffer automatically (formate, acetate, MES, PIPES, MOPS, phosphate, HEPES, Tris, ammonium, carbonate) or use buffer=tris etc. Temperature-corrected pKa (temp_c=), concentration (conc_mm= or conc_m=, default 0.1 M) and volume (volume_ml=, default 1000). Returns grams of the acid and base forms to mix, the single-form route (weigh one form, then mL of 1 M HCl or NaOH to add), buffer capacity, effective pH range, alternatives and practical warnings. Henderson-Hasselbalch; confirm with a pH meter. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_buffer_prep
